parameters.query:
INSERT INTO workflow_errors (workflow, node, execution_id, message, payload)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb) RETURNING id;

parameters.content:
## Global Error Handler
Error workflow for **all** other workflows (n8n never runs it for its own failures, so no loops).

- Masks emails, SA phones, SA ID / card numbers and ciphertext before storing or emailing
- Logs to `workflow_errors` first; the alert email **continues on error**, and so does the log, so one outage can't hide the other
